The model: kinds and ops

Everything in a community is an object of some kind, changed by ops. This page is generated from the model itself, version 2.3.1, sha256 a71fb32573731ca2de99e637834c279fd44d661a947b9542c2d3b088dd10cb13: the same document GET /v2/icd serves.

Who may write: owner means the object's owner; member means anyone on its roster. WallFlowers refuses the rest. Arguments are text or integers. WallFlowers adds gen itself, so it is not listed; GET /v2/icd lists it as required, but leave it out.

What a site reaches: its community, the community's parts (its rooms, its public page), and the objects its own session created. Anything else of the member is refused with … is outside this site's scope. The kinds below the first three are listed for completeness: a site meets them only as a part of its community, or by creating one.

You sayThe model says
communitygroup. The API calls it the Site: session.site is its id, and a site's scope is it and its parts.
roomforum (a part of the community with role room)
public pagehost (a part with role host)
messagean entry in a forum's messages, made by forum.post
threada message and the replies under it (Rooms and threads)

contact

The 1:1 pairing channel: prekey pool + pairwise fan-out.

In this release: Connecting two members is not yet available. The model has the link (contact.setLink: one side's 1 is an invitation, both sides' 1 a link, either side's 0 ends it; a card reaches a connection only after its own side's 1), but no route in this release lets a site, or WallFlowers' app, reach another member to start one.
